dataset.name: Mammals · 4,098 species + lizard outgroup
dataset.release: Dryad version 4, S3 global ML tree (2019-12-06)

references.title: Inferring the mammal tree: Species-level sets of phylogenies for questions in ecology, evolution, and conservation
Inferring the mammal tree: Species-level sets of phylogenies for questions in ecology, evolution, and conservation [dataset, S3]

dataset.evidence: Authors’ global maximum-likelihood tree inferred with RAxML from the 31-gene supermatrix, S3. 4,098 mammal species and Anolis carolinensis outgroup.
dataset.limitations: The DNA-only global ML tree is a single hypothesis, not the completed or dated posterior tree sets. Original species/family/order suffixes and numeric labels are retained. No time scale is claimed.
dataset.changes: Exact extracted Newick entry bytes unchanged; archive SHA and entry path are in the bundled dataset audit. Opening collapses explicit overview groups; later edits are recorded separately.
dataset.rootEvidence: The selected source entry is explicitly named raw_rooted_wBoots_4098mam1out_OK, labels its serialization root Root, and places Anolis carolinensis opposite the mammal clade. The supplied outgroup rooting is retained.

transformations: Selected source tip identities; omitted memberships retained.
Display names shortened to genus and species; original source labels retained.
Nonmetric layouts authored in browser; no dating or relationship inference.
